Northbridge Institute of Technology — admissions office · how to apply

Tests and scores

Standardized testing

For the 2026-27 application cycle, first-year applicants are required to submit the SAT or ACT. Our standardized testing policy is published here and applies to every first-year applicant.

Score submission

Self-reported scores are accepted at the point of application. Official scores are required only if you enrol.
